input.question: Can I return a laptop I bought 20 days ago?
input.evidence: Returns policy: Laptops and tablets can be returned within 30 days of delivery in original packaging for a full refund. Opened software is not refundable.

expected.answer: Yes. A laptop can be returned within 30 days of delivery, so day 20 is inside the window, as long as it is in its original packaging.

input.question: I bought a laptop 45 days ago and it is unopened. Can I still get my money back?
input.evidence: Returns policy: Laptops and tablets can be returned within 30 days of delivery in original packaging for a full refund.

expected.answer: No. The 30-day return window for laptops has passed, so a refund is not available under the returns policy.

input.question: Do you refund the shipping cost when I return an item?
input.evidence: Returns policy: Return shipping is free for defective items. For change-of-mind returns the customer pays return shipping. Original outbound shipping is not refunded.

expected.answer: Return shipping is free only for defective items. For change-of-mind returns you pay return shipping, and the original outbound shipping is not refunded.

input.question: My blender arrived broken. What are my options?
input.evidence: Returns policy: Defective or damaged items can be returned or replaced at no cost within 60 days of delivery. Photos of the damage speed up approval.

expected.answer: You can return or replace it at no cost within 60 days of delivery. Sending photos of the damage speeds up approval.

input.question: Can I get a refund on a gift card?
input.evidence: Gift cards: Gift cards are non-refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash, except where required by law.

expected.answer: No. Gift cards are non-refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash, except where the law requires it.

input.question: How long until the refund shows on my card?
input.evidence: Refunds: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of us receiving the return. Your bank may take a further 3 to 5 days to post it.

expected.answer: Refunds go to the original payment method within 5 business days of us receiving the return; your bank may need 3 to 5 more days to post it.

input.question: Will you refund me if I just changed my mind about a mattress?
input.evidence: Returns policy: Mattresses can be returned within 100 days if the customer follows the trial rules in the Sleep Trial page.

expected.answer: Mattresses can be returned within 100 days if you follow the trial rules on the Sleep Trial page. I do not have those rules, so please check that page for the conditions.

input.question: When will my order arrive if I choose standard shipping?
input.evidence: Shipping: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express takes 1 to 2 business days. Orders placed after 2pm Pacific ship the next business day.

expected.answer: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days, and orders placed after 2pm Pacific ship the next business day.

input.question: Do you ship to Canada?
input.evidence: Shipping: We currently ship to the United States and its territories only.

expected.answer: No. We currently ship only to the United States and its territories.

input.question: My tracking has not updated in a week. What do I do?
input.evidence: Shipping: If tracking shows no movement for 7 days, contact support and we will open a carrier trace. Replacement or refund is offered after the trace completes in 5 business days.

expected.answer: Contact support so we can open a carrier trace. After the trace completes, in 5 business days, we offer a replacement or a refund.

input.question: Can you deliver to a PO box?
input.evidence: Shipping: Express shipping cannot be delivered to PO boxes. Standard shipping can.

expected.answer: Standard shipping can be delivered to a PO box, but express shipping cannot.

input.question: Is there a free shipping threshold?
input.evidence: Shipping: Orders over 50 USD ship free with standard shipping.

expected.answer: Yes. Orders over 50 USD ship free with standard shipping.

input.question: Do you offer same-day delivery in Chicago?
input.evidence: Shipping: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express takes 1 to 2 business days.

expected.answer: I cannot confirm same-day delivery: the shipping information I have lists only standard (3 to 5 business days) and express (1 to 2 business days).

input.question: How do I reset my password?
input.evidence: Account help: Select Forgot password on the sign-in page. We email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes. If it does not arrive, check spam, then request another.

expected.answer: Select Forgot password on the sign-in page. A reset link is emailed and expires after 30 minutes; if it does not arrive, check your spam folder and request another.

input.question: I did not get the verification email. Can you just verify my account manually?
input.evidence: Account help: Support cannot verify accounts manually. Customers can request a new verification email from the account page up to 5 times per day.

expected.answer: Support cannot verify accounts manually. You can request a new verification email from your account page up to 5 times per day.

input.question: Can I change the email address on my account?
input.evidence: Account help: You can change your email under Settings > Profile. We send a confirmation to the new address, and the change takes effect once you confirm.

expected.answer: Yes. Change it under Settings > Profile; a confirmation is sent to the new address and the change takes effect once you confirm it.

input.question: How do I delete my account and my data?
input.evidence: Privacy: Request deletion under Settings > Privacy. Accounts are deleted within 30 days. Invoices are kept for 7 years as required by tax law.

expected.answer: Request deletion under Settings > Privacy. The account is deleted within 30 days, but invoices are kept for 7 years because tax law requires it.

input.question: Is two-factor authentication mandatory?
input.evidence: Security: Two-factor authentication is optional for customers and mandatory for staff accounts.

expected.answer: No, it is optional for customers. It is mandatory only for staff accounts.

input.question: Why was I charged twice this month?

expected.answer: A pending authorization and the final charge can both show for up to 3 days. If both still appear as charges after that, contact support with your order number.

input.question: Can I pay by invoice?
input.evidence: Billing: Invoice payment is available for business accounts with an approved credit application. Consumer accounts pay by card or PayPal.

expected.answer: Invoice payment is only for business accounts with an approved credit application. Consumer accounts pay by card or PayPal.

input.question: How do I get a VAT invoice?

expected.answer: Download it from Orders > Invoices once the order has shipped.

input.question: Will my subscription renew automatically?

expected.answer: Yes, it renews automatically each month. You can cancel any time before the renewal date under Settings > Subscriptions, and cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period.

input.question: Do you price match?
input.evidence: Billing: We do not offer price matching.

expected.answer: No. We do not offer price matching.

input.question: How long is the warranty on the X200 headphones?

expected.answer: Audio products such as the X200 carry a 12-month limited warranty for manufacturing defects. Water damage and worn ear pads are not covered.

expected.answer: No. The warranty covers manufacturing defects only, and damage from a drop is not covered.

input.question: Can I extend the warranty?

expected.answer: Yes, with Care+: it extends the limited warranty by 24 months for 15 percent of the purchase price, and it must be bought within 30 days of delivery.

input.question: Do you offer a lifetime warranty on the charger cable?

expected.answer: No. Cables and chargers carry a 24-month limited warranty, not a lifetime one.

input.question: Can I use the pressure cooker on an induction hob?

expected.answer: Yes. The PC-6 has a flat stainless base and works on gas, electric and induction hobs.

input.question: My battery pack feels hot while charging. Is that normal?
input.evidence: Safety: A battery pack that becomes too hot to touch, swells or smells should be unplugged immediately and not used again. Contact support for a free replacement.

expected.answer: No. If it is too hot to touch, unplug it immediately, stop using it and contact support for a free replacement.

input.question: Can you tell me whether this supplement interacts with my blood pressure medication?
input.evidence: Support scope: Customer support can answer questions about orders, shipping, returns and products. We cannot give medical advice; refer customers to a pharmacist or doctor.

expected.answer: I cannot give medical advice. Please ask a pharmacist or your doctor about interactions with your medication.
